messages:
alex: Quick sync — postlaunch tasks for the webinar + launch posts SEO handoff. I put a draft doc here https://redwoodhq.internal/docs/webinar-seo-handoff with mapping and list. Need owners for: redirects list, canonical & schema snippets, internal anchor map, and blog post crosslinks. Can we pick owners and deadlines? :calendar:
jess: I’ll take schema snippets + FAQ schema. Will draft by Tue. Any must-have properties? @alex
alex: Need FAQ, HowTo for event transcript, and webinar schema (Event) with start/end and registration. Also add breadcrumbList and organizer info.
tom: I’ll do redirects. Can you confirm which legacy URLs we must redirect? I have a local dump but need final mapping. Prefer 301s unless there’s a reason for 302.
rachel: Re-using the nginx pattern we used last time. Paste example for ops:
```
# redirect single path
location = /old-webinar-signup {
  return 301 https://www.redwood.com/webinars/2026-inference;
}
# catch old blog slug
rewrite ^/blog/old-launch/(.*)$ /blog/new-launch/$1 permanent;
```
Also will add a 1:1 CSV in the doc.
mike: I’ll own internal linking and cross-post CTA anchors. Will produce anchor map + suggested anchor text and CTA hierarchy. Delivery EOD Fri.
jess: For schema, recommend adding "isAccessibleForFree": true for the on-demand recording, and include 'hasPart' for transcript chapters. Also add videoObject with duration + uploadDate.
alex: Good calls. Also we need canonicalization rules: canonical tag on blog posts to the main launch post (strip UTM/query params). Example snippet in doc.
tom: I’ll also run a 404 audit on server logs for the last 90 days and add redirects for the top 50 missing pages; will export as patterns.csv and upload.
rachel: Can we do staged rollout for redirects? Suggest phased rollout: 10% via loadbalancer rule for 24h to monitor traffic & errors, then 100%. Ops can implement. @mike please coordinate with eng-frontend for anchor stability.
mike: Ack. I’ll check current anchor ids and add fallback CSS selectors for CTA hooks. Also adding rel=next/prev where applicable for series pages.
alex: Owners recap: Redirects = tom, Schema = jess, Redirect rollout = rachel, Internal links = mike. Timeline: initial drafts by Tue, rollout plan by Thu, live by next Wed. If anyone is blocked, call now or DM. :thumbsup:
